paragraphs.text: Mons was a goblin Pashalik, a renowned warrior who lived in Modern Times in Rundvelt , part of southern Aerona in the Domains of Dominaria .
Mons walked with a limp and was short in his old age. He had an incredible presence and commanded respect.

Mons pioneered the goblin Sled Corps, whose reputation for breaking through enemy defenses grew his exploits into legends, earning him the title of Pashalik. They were held back by the Olesians and the Nalathni dragons . Mons was a living hero to the Rundvelt goblins in his lifetime, even becoming the hero in the popular goblin children's game "Raid the Village". Mons also sat on a council with other goblin dignitaries, Pashaliks, and priests.
In the Un-iverse , Mons ran a restaurant and a bowling team.

Mons was named after Mons Johnson , a longtime friend of Richard Garfield who playtested Alpha and later worked at Wizards of the Coast . The Japanese TCG Duel Masters also features a card called Mons's Goblin Raiders .
